# block_specific_pockets_and_write { #mofography.raspa_helper.block_specific_pockets_and_write }

```python
raspa_helper.block_specific_pockets_and_write(
    file_path,
    rag,
    ase_atoms,
    pocket_ids_to_block,
)
```

Takes specific pocket IDs and writes their blocking information to a file.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name                | Type   | Description                                                        | Default    |
|---------------------|--------|--------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| file_path           |        | the path to the file you want to write the blocking information to | _required_ |
| rag                 |        | the networkx graph object                                          | _required_ |
| ase_atoms           |        | ASE atoms object                                                   | _required_ |
| pocket_ids_to_block |        | list of pocket IDs to block                                        | _required_ |
